design rule: at least 80 % of a pair's length runs at its gap (the rest is the fan-out at the ends)

design rule: a class that carries 0.5 A or more uses the large via, the others the signal via
design rule: a class that needs more than 0.8 mm on the inner copper stays on the outer layers
design rule: 1.5 x the IPC-2221 width (the formulas are for a free-standing track and carry a +-10 % scatter)
design rule: power and ground links at least 0.3 mm (1.5 x the signal width: less drop, a via fits on the track)
